blurb: Plan a visit to our tasting room, one of the top attractions near Croswell and Lexington. You’ll find tasting flights of wine and hard cider, refreshing sangrias and frosé, plus a selection of charcuterie boards featuring items grown in our gardens. Our tasting room is open-air when the weather permits, so dress for the season. In the winter, you’ll stay cozy with radiant heaters while enjoying the vineyard views
